name: Ogawa Aoi
source:
2nd year high school student.
She mysteriously lost her memories one year ago, and after that she became an isolated girl that was afraid to interact with others.
But she ended up joining the science club by chance, and it became the place where she felt like she relied upon and belonged to the most.
